eyebrow: Comments: identical on all four platforms
code:
-- Single-line comment: same everywhere
SELECT * FROM Orders; -- trailing comment

/* Block comment: also identical
   across every dialect */
caption: One of the rare areas with zero divergence between dialects.

code:
-- Historically optional for most statements...
SELECT * FROM Sales.Orders

-- ...but newer syntax like CTEs REQUIRES it before WITH
caption: T-SQL is the loose one — but that's changing.
Without it, the parser can't tell where one statement ends.
